PZZ700-290915-
130 PM PDT Wed Oct 28 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 1025 mb high was 500 nautical miles west of Cape
Mendocino and a 1010 mb low covered the lower Colorado River
Valley. A weak offshore land breeze is expected near shore during
the nights and mornings, with onshore flow prevailing each 
afternoon and evening through early Saturday. As a storm system is
forecast to move through the coastal waters this weekend, winds 
and seas are likely to increase by Sunday, possibly to hazardous 
levels.

$$
